summary: Tested the 4 new features: Room Inspiration (home section + /inspiration), Recently Viewed, the Kit Quote dialog with admin verification, and the kit-aware WhatsApp link. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass. Frontend: all 7 requested checks pass on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). No console errors and no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: For inquiry_type 'kit-quote', the backend accepts an empty phone (returns 200). Only the frontend 'required' attribute enforces it, so direct API calls can create kit quotes with no phone.

issues: The hamburger toggle button has no data-testid (testability only).

action_items: Optional: when inquiry_type == 'kit-quote', require a non-empty phone in the backend.
Optional: add a data-testid to the mobile hamburger toggle in Nav.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Kits.jsx IntersectionObserver uses a -45% rootMargin, so on the hero area above the first kit the WhatsApp text stays on the last kit that intersected (or Living Room on load). This is acceptable behaviour.
RecentlyViewed stores up to 10 entries with a cached price, so prices can go stale if Shopify prices change. Minor.
Inspiration tiles use loading=lazy inside a Reveal fade. Images load correctly after scrolling (all naturalWidth > 0).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ inquiries: TEST_Kit_*, TEST_nophone, and 'TEST_UI Kit Buyer' (Dining Kit, Pune).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: home-inspiration has 3 tiles and view-all goes to /inspiration. /inspiration has 6 tiles and all 6 product handles load. recently-viewed excludes the current product and also appears on home. Kit quote: dialog title, required-field validation, success toast and dialog close all work, and admin inquiries shows 'Kit: Dining Kit · phone · city'. WhatsApp text changes per kit and resets to 'Hi' off /kits. Product pages use 'Hi, I'm interested in <NAME>'. Mobile menu has nav-inspiration. Admin login goes through /auth (auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit) and then /adore-admin.
